[[File:Ogre chieftain chathead.png|left|100px]]
The '''ogre chieftain''' is an ogre that can be found in the [[Feldip Hills]]. They can also be found guarding and inside the [[Ogre Enclave]]. These have a slow respawn, high life points, hit frequently and have very few drops making them not very good to train on. Killing normal [[ogres]] instead would be recommended.
